data.title: Middle East regional order may be shifting in Israel's favor | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Israel-Lebanon negotiations, a possible Syrian security arrangement, and renewed Bahrain-Israel engagement point to diplomatic movement - but analysts disagree over the durability of potential deals.
